name: Combine RSS feeds and Hugging Face datasets into a quality-checked CSV

parameters.content:
## Combine RSS feeds and Hugging Face datasets into a quality-checked CSV

### How it works

This workflow runs every three days, reads configuration values, then pulls marketing data from two Hugging Face datasets and four RSS feeds. Each source is mapped into a unified schema, merged, and passed through a quality-checking and cleaning step. The cleaned records are exported as a CSV, while a separate quality report is generated as JSON for documentation and auditing.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger interval if every three days is not the desired cadence.
- Review the Configure Sources node and set the Hugging Face dataset names, row limits, offsets, and RSS feed URLs as needed.
- Ensure the HTTP Request nodes can access the Hugging Face datasets-server endpoints; add authentication headers if you switch to private datasets.
- Verify the Convert to CSV and Convert Report to JSON nodes produce files in the expected format and connect them to storage, email, or another delivery destination if needed.

### Customization

You can add or replace RSS sources, adjust the number of Hugging Face rows fetched per run, change the unified schema in the mapping code nodes, or tighten the quality rules before export.

## Schedule and configure

Starts the workflow on a recurring schedule and defines shared source settings such as dataset names, row counts, and offsets before branching to all data sources.

## Fetch Hugging Face datasets

Retrieves the two Hugging Face datasets and maps ad copy and campaign performance records into the workflow’s unified schema.

## Read and map RSS

Reads the four marketing RSS feeds, appends them together, and converts feed articles into the same unified record structure as the dataset sources.

## Merge and clean records

Combines the mapped Hugging Face and RSS records into one stream, then applies quality checks and cleaning logic to every record.

## Create CSV export

Transforms the cleaned record bundle into one item per row and converts the result into a CSV file.

## Create quality report

Builds summary quality metrics from the cleaned data and converts the report into a JSON file.
